explanation.headline: FDA's records show the dexmedetomidine hydrochloride shortage has been listed since 2020-04-10 with multiple manufacturers reporting discontinuation of manufacture and no current signal at our plants

sentences.text: FDA first posted the dexmedetomidine hydrochloride shortage on 2020-04-10 and as of 2026-10-21 it has been on the list for 78 months.

The FDA shortage list shows multiple manufacturers with current status including Accord Healthcare Inc. reporting discontinuation of manufacture, Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Azurity Pharmaceuticals Inc., Baxter Healthcare, Eugia US LLC, Fresenius Kabi USA LLC with estimated recovery TBD, Gland Pharma Limited, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., HQ Specialty Pharma, Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co. reporting discontinuation of manufacture, Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co. Ltd., and Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc.
Corvale General holds 483 units at 23.8 units per day providing 20 days on hand, while Corvale East holds 104 units at 15.5 units per day providing 7 days on hand.
The rule-based best option is to transfer 113 units from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would leave Corvale General with two weeks of supply and bring Corvale East to 14 days on hand.

Alternative manufacturer options include buying from Avenacy Inc. whose plant is HENGRUI PHARMA, or from CIVICA INC. whose label names no plant we could place, neither of which are on FDA's shortage list today.

rejected.text: No public FDA signal exists at our plants for this drug.

Q-6519d7.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%dexmedetomidine%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%dexmedetomidine%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key
